now.title: Luke Cage S2#12
now.text: Tilda Johnson treats Bushmaster with her herbs. They start as enemies and become allies.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A herbalist who treats Bushmaster. They start as enemies and become allies.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A patient Tilda treats with her herbs. An enemy who becomes an ally.

proposed.text: Tilda urges Bushmaster to kill her mother, shows him the secret passages into Harlem's Paradise and gives him a supershot of nightshade.

changes.evidence: In Luke Cage S2#12 (Can't Front on Me) Tilda tells Bushmaster her mother must be killed, tells him about the secret passageways at Harlem's Paradise and gives him a supershot of nightshade. The current text is a summary of their whole arc (the healing is S2#9/S2#11), not this episode's events.

now.title: Luke Cage S2#12
now.text: Misty keeps hunting Shades as he runs Mariah's operations, until he turns on Mariah and hands Misty the evidence to arrest her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's lieutenant, who finally hands Misty the evidence to arrest Mariah.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A detective who hunts Shades until he hands her evidence against Mariah.

proposed.text: Misty takes Shades's confession in return for immunity and sends him back to Mariah for the gun, which he hands over as the evidence against her.

changes.evidence: Shades surrendered to Misty in S2#11, so in S2#12 she is not hunting him while he runs Mariah's operations: she organizes his official testimony for full immunity, tells him the deal fails unless he gets Mariah's revolver, and he hands her the gun at Harlem's Paradise.

now.title: Luke Cage S2#13
now.text: Disappointed when Luke takes over Harlem's Paradise, D.W. tells him Pop's is neutral ground where he can get a haircut but not talk business.
now.on_a_card_about_b: D.W.'s hero, whom he scolds for taking over Harlem's Paradise.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A young fan who scolds Luke for taking over Harlem's Paradise.

proposed.text: Disappointed that Luke is stepping in as Harlem's crime boss, D.W. tells him Pop's is neutral ground where he can get a haircut but not talk business.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: D.W.'s hero, whom he scolds for acting as Harlem's crime boss.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A young fan who scolds Luke for acting as Harlem's crime boss.

changes.evidence: In S2#13 D.W. confronts Luke at Pop's after he has started policing the gangs ('if you're gonna be the boss of crime, then you're a crime boss... this place is Switzerland'). This happens before Mariah's will is read; Luke only gets Harlem's Paradise in the later will-reading scene, so the text and both card lines put the scolding on the wrong event.

now.title: Luke Cage S2#13
now.text: Mariah Dillard is Tilda Johnson's mother, but Mama Mabel had Tilda taken from her, and Mamie Johnson raised her. Tilda poisons Mariah in prison.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's daughter, raised apart from her. Poisons Mariah in prison.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Tilda's mother, who was kept from raising her. Tilda poisons her in prison.

proposed.text: Tilda visits Mariah in jail and turns down her offer to start over. Her goodbye kiss carries a poison that soon kills Mariah.

changes.evidence: The first sentence (Mabel had Tilda taken, Mamie Johnson raised her) is the S2#8 revelation, already the S2#8 stage. In S2#13 Tilda puts a poison on her lips, visits Mariah in jail, refuses her offer to start over, kisses her goodbye, and Mariah later dies of it.

owner_calls.question: Who arrests Mariah at Harlem's Paradise in Luke Cage S2#12: Ridley or Misty? The stage text and both card lines say Ridley arrests her (st-priscilla-ridley|st-tom-ridenhour:2 also says 'she arrests Mariah Dillard').
options: Change to Misty arresting Mariah with Ridley there (e.g. 'Ridley backs the case against Mariah, and after Shades hands over the gun, Mariah is arrested at her club' with cards adjusted)
owner_calls.evidence: Sources conflict. The MCU wiki's episode page, Misty Knight page and Shades page say Knight arrests Mariah once Shades hands her the gun; the Priscilla Ridley and Mariah Stokes pages say Ridley takes her into custody and tells her a court of law will convict her. The episode transcript has the arrest line ('Mariah Stokes Dillard, you are under arrest...') without speaker labels. Wikipedia only says 'Dillard is arrested.'
